subject.title: fix(cron): clean up recurring jobs converted to one-shot

question: Should this normal cron fix retain its manual unreleased `CHANGELOG.md` entry despite the repository policy that makes release notes release-owned?
rationale: The existing review comment and author response express conflicting interpretations of repository policy; resolving that exception is maintainer intent rather than a mechanical correctness judgment.

options.title: Remove the manual changelog entry
options.body: Keep the user-visible release-note context in the PR body and let the release-owned process generate `CHANGELOG.md` content.

options.title: Approve a one-off changelog exception
options.body: Retain the entry only if maintainers intentionally want this fix included manually in the current release-owned changelog.

recommendation.title: Remove the manual changelog entry
recommendation.body: Keep the user-visible release-note context in the PR body and let the release-owned process generate `CHANGELOG.md` content.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the branch and directly stated the rationale for retaining the disputed changelog entry.
